items.title: MEA India
items.summary: The Indian ambassador met the forensic team now in Nepal, where they'll work with local experts on DNA samples to help identify victims of the recent flash floods. @MEAIndia

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: The Indian ambassador met the forensic team now in Nepal, where they're teaming up with local experts to run DNA tests on remains from the recent floods. @MEAIndia

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted a list of foreign citizens rescued on August 29, 2026.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted an update on the Bhote Koshi flood: 626 bodies have been recovered, about 2400 people are still missing, and more than 4450 have been rescued so far, including over 187 foreign nationals. Search and checks are still underway.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: India's technical team checked the hydropower tunnels in the flooded area to help locate people still stranded. @MEAIndia

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ shared a page for families checking on foreign citizens who are rescued, missing, injured, or unidentified. You can find the details through the link they posted.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal says the embassy is still working with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indians caught in the flash floods. Their First Secretary met some rescued Indian workers today.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: A team from India went into the hydropower tunnels in the flooded area today to help locate people who are still missing. @IndiainNepal

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu @IndiainNepal is still working with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by the flash floods. Their First Secretary met some recently rescued Indian workers today.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu @IndiainNepal is still working with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the flash floods. Their First Secretary met some recently rescued Indian workers today.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal says an Indian technical team went into the hydropower tunnels in the flooded area today to help speed up the search for people still missing.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal said the Foreign Minister held a press briefing today on the government’s search, rescue and relief efforts after the floods in the Bhote Koshi River.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal shared a Nepal Police link with details on unidentified bodies from the Rasuwa floods.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal says rescue teams are still working after the big flood on August 26 in Rasuwa, with ongoing risks and travel issues along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers through Mugling.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal says flash floods hit the Bhote Koshi River area on the 26th, with 538 bodies recovered so far and 511 people from 33 countries still missing as searches go on. Their emergency line is +977-9744441227.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal has posted links to daily updates on foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood, with the latest at 15:00 hrs NST on 28 August 2026.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal has opened an emergency control room to help foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood. The links point to contact details.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal has set up an emergency response team to help foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood. They shared links with more information.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal has an emergency control room helping foreign nationals caught in the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa. Reach them on WhatsApp or phone at +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm) or email emergency@mofa.gov.np.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: If you're checking on family in Nepal, @MEAIndia has opened a control room for the floods. Reach them at +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or situationroom@mea.gov.in.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal shared that a big flash flood hit Rasuwagadhi, Timure, Syafrubesi and communities downstream on August 26, with major road closures reported in Rasuwa District and along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani river corridors.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: For the Bhotekoshi and Rasuwa flash flood, @NDRRMA_Nepal is sharing rescue updates on their portal at ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and the SETU site at setu.ndrrma.gov.np.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: Nepal’s foreign minister @shisir spoke by phone today with the UK’s Ed Miliband @Ed_Miliband, who shared his thoughts on the situation.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: Families can check Nepal Police lists of people found, missing, or unidentified after the floods at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np. @NepalPoliceHQ shared the link here

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal posted that the United States sends its condolences to the families who lost loved ones in the Rasuwa floods.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: The US is thinking of the families who lost loved ones in the Rasuwa floods and sends its condolences. @USEmbassyNepal

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu (@IndiainNepal) is working with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the flash floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Reach out to the MEA control room or the embassy if you need help—their site is indembkathmandu.gov.in.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal notes that Nepali authorities are warning about severe flooding in Rasuwa and along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani rivers. Families in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, or Tanahun should stay clear of riverbanks and low-lying spots.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal is saddened by the loss of life from the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa district and sends condolences to the families. Their thoughts are with those affected.
